items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev uses his length well and possesses good technical striking with forward pressure.
items.quote: He's long, he uses length pretty well. He has wrestling as a backup plan. It is squarely plan B, not plan A. But he's a long dude. He's got good technical striking, good forward pressure.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev was sick or injured going into his recent fight against Alex Pereira.
items.quote: What was he? Sick or injured, whatever it was going into his last fight, I believe it. I genuinely believe it.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev beat Alex Pereira pretty handily in their first fight by being the busier striker and moving forward.
items.quote: he beat Alex Pereira pretty handily. He used the one who moved forward. Yeah, he didn't get takedowns, but he moved forward. He was the busier striker.

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov is taking this fight on short notice of two weeks.
items.quote: He's getting Bogdan Guskov on short notice. Bogdan Guskov is stepping up on two weeks notice.

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov possesses big one-punch knockout power and can head hunt.
items.quote: Bogdan Guskov does have big one-punch knockout power, and he can head hunt, and he can find that spot.
